program.section_heading: Advanced Collision Repair - Associate of Science Degree and Certificate of Achievement - AS1122/AS1122C/CE1122
outcomes: Demonstrate proficiency in advanced collision repair methods, including structural and non-structural repairs, consistent with manufacturer specifications and industry standards.
Prepare, refinish, and detail automotive surfaces using contemporary coatings, materials, and equipment to achieve high-quality, industry-accepted results.
Safely and effectively apply powder coating techniques, from surface preparation to curing, in accordance with environmental and quality control standards.
Identify, assess, and resolve complex repair and refinishing challenges using modern diagnostic tools and critical thinking strategies.
Adhere to OSHA and EPA standards by maintaining safe work practices, proper hazardous material handling, and environmentally responsible procedures.
Demonstrate effective communication, teamwork, and professionalism in a simulated or real-world collision repair environment, reflecting readiness for employment in the automotive industry.

notes: The catalog section covers both the A.S. Degree and the Certificate of Achievement with a single requirements list and a single Program Learning Outcomes list; the A.S. Degree shares these, so they are recorded here.
Total of 20.00 units is the major total; the degree also requires general education and other graduation requirements, but no specific GE pattern is named in the text.
Codes printed with a hyphen (e.g., AUB-50) correspond to closed-list codes (e.g., AUB 50).
